newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK ETANE SAYS PROJECT BACKLOG AT 6.8 BLN DRS.
newsitem.headline: GREEK ETANE SAYS PROJECT BACKLOG AT 6.8 BLN DRS.

text.p: Athens bourse newcomer Etane said in a statement that its order book of uncompleted projects stood at 6.8 billion drachmas ($24 million) following the award of new contracts for private projects.

ELKEPRO, the industrial arm of the Etane group, will proceed with building a second unit to produce prefabricated construction components in the industrial zone of Komotini in Northern Greece, it said.

The investment is budgeted at 541 million drachmas and 62 percent of the production cost will be subsidized. The interest rate on a bank loan amounting to 110 million drachmas will also be subsidized at a rate of 62 percent, it said.
The company recently signed a deal with Mitsubishi Chemicals, represented in Greece by Sumitomo Hellas to collaborate in using fiber-reinforced-plastics technology to repair concrete constructions.

Etane, a parallel market listing, tapped the market for 777 million drachmas, issuing 400,000 common registered shares with a par value of 100 at 1,850 drachmas. It also placed 20,000 shares privately with staff at 1,850 drachmas.
Its IPO was oversubscribed 10 times. It closed 15 drachmas lower at 1,730 drachmas on Monday. ($1 = 281.50 drachmas) --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
